title: API integration services | Christopher Bengtsson
description: Connect applications and business data with a senior software engineer. Focused API integrations, workflow automation and integration fixes, delivered remotely.
headline: API integrations for a clearly defined business need
introduction: I help operations and product teams connect applications and business data. Start with one connection to build, one failing flow to investigate, or one manual step to automate.

examples.title: Connect a form to a business system
examples.description: Bring information from an application into a CRM or another service, with an agreed mapping and validation rules.

examples.title: Investigate a failing integration
examples.description: Follow a specific failed request or data mismatch across systems and identify what needs to change.

examples.title: Automate a recurring step
examples.description: Replace a defined manual transfer or notification step with a connection your team can understand and maintain.

sections.title: Start with one manual workflow
paragraphs: I map the current steps, inputs and decision points. We agree one workflow to automate, where human approval is needed and how exceptions should be handled.
I can also assess where AI could help with text or documents. We agree how to check its output and when human review is needed.
The first assignment can be a repeated data transfer, notification or approval step. If an existing connector or automation platform meets the need, we can consider it before I build custom code.
You receive the agreed implementation and checks, with handover notes describing the flow, configuration and remaining limitations.

sections.title: Connect two systems—or fix the connection
paragraphs: I assess the source and destination, the available API or supported interface, and the access needed. The connection can use a modern API or an existing interface such as SOAP/XML.
For one agreed data flow, I define field mapping and validation. We agree which failure cases to cover, including error reporting and, where needed, retries that avoid duplicate actions.

You receive the implemented connection or investigation findings, with checks and practical handover notes. If implementation cannot yet be estimated, we can start with a separately agreed, paid investigation and proposed scope. Each assignment is quoted individually.

steps.title: Describe the change
steps.description: Tell me what exists, what you want to achieve and any deadline. A reproducible problem or a concrete example helps us start.

steps.title: Agree a scope
steps.description: We identify the deliverable, the access needed and how to check that the work is complete. I confirm availability before we agree a schedule.

steps.title: Build or review
steps.description: I work within the agreed scope and explain findings or tradeoffs. If new work emerges, we discuss it before extending the assignment.

steps.title: Hand over
steps.description: You receive the agreed changes or findings, with practical notes on what was checked and what needs attention next.

questions.question: Can you integrate with our CRM?
questions.answer: Share the platform, the data you want to exchange and the access available. My experience includes a KYC workflow connected to Salesforce; I assess each new platform rather than assume its APIs behave the same way.

questions.question: What if one system has no API?
questions.answer: I can check whether there is a supported alternative such as an export, import or existing service interface. Feasibility depends on the access and constraints of that system.

questions.question: Does the integration need AI?
questions.answer: Not necessarily. Moving and validating structured data often needs ordinary software. AI can be considered for a specific task where its output can be checked and exceptions handled.

experience: At Trustly, I co-built a KYC workflow with another full-stack developer: React forms, validation in an Express service, Postgres storage through Prisma and a connection to Salesforce. Through Headlight/Relight, I also built and maintained a change-request portal for Trafikverket, primarily using K2’s process engine and SmartForms. That assignment supports my workflow automation experience.
contactIntro: Describe the workflow or integration you want to improve and one example of the desired result. Please leave out credentials and sensitive data.
contactPlaceholder: Which tools are involved? What happens today, and what should change? Include any deadline and, if known, a budget range.
